buyer: Owner or studio manager for a 2-12 artist tattoo studio

steps.name: Qualify the consultation
steps.action: Collect placement, size, style, references, budget range, and artist preference
steps.output: Consult brief routed to a studio owner
steps.gate: Studio checks age, scope, and artist fit

steps.name: Approve the design brief
steps.action: Summarize creative direction and revision boundary

steps.name: Stage the deposit
steps.action: Prepare a disabled Stripe deposit preset and terms acknowledgment
steps.gate: No charge; owner must approve amount, refund terms, and live mode

steps.name: Reserve the session
steps.action: Create the matching event-type reservation and preparation note
steps.output: Confirmed artist session with prep checklist

steps.name: Queue aftercare
steps.action: Prepare aftercare, healing check-in, and rebooking tasks
steps.gate: No customer message sends from this starter
